name: メンバーを管理するシート
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. ONE real Lighthouse component LH03-0019「メンバーを管理するシート」.
Reference priority: Image1 ORIGINAL controls icon shape, fine stroke/optical weight, spacing, role/shield anatomy, close and destructive meaning. Image2 Japanese mock is secondary for exact Japanese copy and locked typography/logical390x252 structure; repair its missing admin shield/check, wrong green destructive color, mint avatar and omitted close-circle. Image3 approved white rounded card style only.
Render ONE compact white rounded-top member action sheet, no phone, no background screen. Top header: small40px WHITE outlined avatar with forestgreen「佐」, exact name「佐藤 ゆう」Meiryo Bold14/24, right neutral circular close button with original X. The body is a white soft rounded grouped card: row1 exact「情報を見る」with original circled lowercase i at RIGHT; row2 exact「管理者にする」with original outline bust/person AND small filled shield with white check at lower right, same geometry and weight as original, at RIGHT. A subtle inset divider separates these2rows. Below, separate white rounded destructive action row exact「グループから外す」with original outlined circle containing horizontal minus at RIGHT. BOTH label and minus-circle are source-faithful RED, because removal is destructive. No green removal icon. Original shows a removal action, not a completed removal or selected state. No added confirmations/toggles/chevrons/badges/rows.
Typography: all3row labels Meiryo Regular14px/24px; member name and avatar initial Bold14/24, all tracking0 and original Japanese wording single-line. Preserve relative font size and weight uniformly at larger output scale. Names/body#1D1D1D; supporting icons#526173; close slate. White page/canvas/card#FFFFFF, very fine neutral borders and soft restrained elevation. Keep logical390x252 compact hierarchy and native alignment. All controls legible with usable rows; do not enlarge header text to20px.
Accent decision: original lavender avatar is decorative identity, omit tinted fill for white outline/initial. Red removal has real destructive meaning and must be retained consistently on its label and icon. Informational/admin utility icons remain same slate. No primary green button or decorative accent required here.
One complete component centered on landscape3:2 purewhite canvas with modest margins. Exact contents, source fine controls, white surfaces. This is a static raster candidate; no invented product behavior.
reviewNotes: 原画像の情報i・管理者の人物とチェック入り盾・丸い閉じる・赤い除外記号を優先しモックの欠落を復元。DESIGN現行ルールで緑の危険操作を赤い文言と記号へ修正。出力を目視し佐/佐藤 ゆう・3操作の全文・白面・2群・穏やかな影・欠落なしを確認。アバターは白に薄い輪郭、本人識別のみ緑。厳密な字体計測・ベクトル同一性・実権限/除外操作・編集可能性・所有者承認は未検証。
